data.gender_notes: Padmalochan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Padma: Lotus, Lochana: Face. This name is derived from the Hindu deity Vishnu, who is often depicted with a lotus flower on his navel and four arms, each holding a symbol. The name Padmalochan signifies one who possesses a radiant, lotus-like face and embodies the divine qualities of love, compassion, and power. The name Padmalochan carries the meaning “Lotus-faced Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Padmalochan usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus-faced lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Radiates inner beauty and divine grace.
data.etymology: Padmalochan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus-faced Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Padmalochan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Padmalochan carries a rich cultural significance as it is derived from Hindu mythology. In Hinduism, Vishnu, the preserver deity, is often depicted with a lotus flower on his navel, representing creation. The name Padmalochan serves as a reminder of this divine figure and the symbolism of the lotus flower as a symbol of purity, creation, and rebirth.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Padmalochan lies in the qualities it represents. The name signifies the inner beauty and radiance of one's soul. It is a reminder to strive to embody the virtues of love, compassion, and power, just as Vishnu is known to do. Additionally, the lotus symbol in the name reminds us of the potential for spiritual growth and rebirth within ourselves. By carrying the name Padmalochan, one can be inspired to cultivate a pure mind and heart, and to live a compassionate and loving life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Padmalochan signifies one who resides in the lotus (Padma) and is the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom (Lochan). It is a reminder of the divine teacher, Lord Buddha, who is often depicted seated on a lotus flower.

historical_references.reference: Padmalochan is mentioned in 'Brihaddharma Purana' as a title given to Buddha when he assumed the lotus seat after his enlightenment.
Padmalochan is also known as the name of the Hindu deity Vishnu in his lotus form, symbolizing purity and divinity.
